fields.description: Only enabled settings show in the sign and verify dialogs. Use the buttons of the form to change it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The app makes PAdES signatures, the standard for signed PDF files.
fields.label: Algorithm

fields.description: Approval: other people can sign the PDF after you. Certification: the first signature of the PDF. It sets which changes are allowed after it. With No Changes, any later change makes the signature not valid. With Form Filling and Signing, other people can fill the form fields and sign. A PDF can have only one certification signature, and it must be the first.
fields.label: Signature Type
fields.options:
Approval
Certification: No Changes
Certification: Form Filling and Signing

fields.description: Why you sign, for example "I approve this document". PDF readers show it in the signature panel.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Where you sign, for example the city. PDF readers show it in the signature panel.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: An email or a phone to contact the signer. PDF readers show it in the signature panel.
fields.label: Contact Information

fields.description: Optional. The address of a time stamp authority (TSA), for example https://freetsa.org/tsr. The TSA adds a trusted date and time to the signature (PAdES B-T). If it is empty, the signature has the time of the server only.
fields.label: Time Stamp Authority URL

fields.description: Optional. The user, if the TSA needs one.
fields.label: TSA User

fields.description: Optional. The password, if the TSA needs one.
fields.label: TSA Password

fields.description: The root certificate of the TSA (.cer, .crt or .pem). The verification uses it to trust the time stamps. Get it from the website of the TSA.
fields.label: TSA Root Certificate

fields.description: Add to the PDF the revocation data (OCSP or CRL) of the certificates and a document time stamp (PAdES B-LTA). Then the signature can be validated after the certificate expires. The certificate must give OCSP or CRL addresses, and the server must reach them and the TSA.
fields.label: Long-Term Validation

fields.description: Only these users can sign with this setting. Use it for a personal certificate. If you add users, the roles below are not used for signing.
fields.label: Users That Can Sign

fields.description: Users with one of these roles can sign with this setting. If it is empty and there are no users, only the PDF Signer Manager and the System Manager can sign.
fields.label: Roles That Can Sign

fields.description: Users with one of these roles can verify signatures with this setting. If it is empty, all the users that can read the PDF can verify.
fields.label: Roles That Can Verify

fields.description: Show a box with the signature on a page. If it is off, the signature is invisible: PDF readers show it only in the signature panel.
fields.label: Visible Signature

fields.description: The page of the signature box.
fields.label: Page
fields.options:
First Page
Last Page
Page Number

fields.description: The number of the page. The first page is 1. If the PDF has fewer pages, the app does not sign.
fields.label: Page Number

fields.description: The place of the signature box on the page. With Custom, you give the distance from the bottom-left corner of the page.
fields.label: Position
fields.options:
Bottom Left
Bottom Center
Bottom Right
Top Left
Top Center
Top Right
Custom

fields.description: The width of the signature box in millimeters.
fields.label: Width (mm)

fields.description: The height of the signature box in millimeters.
fields.label: Height (mm)

fields.description: The distance in millimeters between the signature box and the edges of the page.
fields.label: Margin (mm)

fields.description: The distance in millimeters from the left edge of the page to the left side of the box.
fields.label: Distance from the Left (mm)

fields.description: The distance in millimeters from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom side of the box.
fields.label: Distance from the Bottom (mm)

fields.description: Text: only the text. Text and QR Code: the text and a QR code. Background Image: the text on an image. Handwritten Signature: the text on a signature that you draw.
fields.label: Style
fields.options:
Text
Text and QR Code
Background Image
Handwritten Signature

fields.description: The place of the QR code in the signature box.
fields.label: QR Code Position
fields.options:
Left of Text
Right of Text
Above Text
Below Text

fields.description: The text or the web address in the QR code. If it is empty, the QR code contains the Additional Text, or the address of this site.
fields.label: QR Code Content

fields.description: A PNG or JPG image behind the text, for example a stamp of the company.
fields.label: Background Image

fields.description: Draw your signature. The app puts it behind the text.
fields.label: Handwritten Signature

fields.description: The color of the drawn signature in the PDF. The color of the drawing pad does not change the PDF.
fields.label: Handwritten Signature Color

fields.description: 100% shows the image or the drawn signature with full color. A lower value makes it lighter, so that the text is easier to read.
fields.label: Background Opacity

fields.description: The text of the signature box. You can use these variables: %(signer)s the name of the certificate holder, %(ts)s the date and time of the signature, %(reason)s, %(location)s and %(additional)s.
fields.label: Text

fields.description: A text for the variable %(additional)s, for example the name of the company.
fields.label: Additional Text

fields.description: The format of %(ts)s. %d day, %m month, %Y year, %H hour, %M minutes, %S seconds, %Z time zone.
fields.label: Date Format

fields.description: Optional. A TTF or OTF font for the text. If it is empty, the app uses a standard PDF font. That font shows letters with accents and the letter ñ, but not other special characters.
fields.label: Font File

fields.description: The size of the text in points.
fields.label: Text Size

fields.description: The color of the text.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: The width of the line around the box, in points. 0 means no border.
fields.label: Border Width

fields.description: The color of the line around the box.
fields.label: Border Color
